Hannah (CS): Alert: several onboarding tenants reported missing documents after indexing around 07:12 UTC. Need customer status line, credits guidance, and quick enablement reschedule.

Ravi - CS Ops: Segment by impact: blocking (can't go-live), partial (search incomplete), retryable. I'll export lists.

Hannah (CS): Blocking: acct-nova, acct-orbit. Partial: ~10 trials. CSV going to #cs-ops-docs now.

Eve (Support): Suggest: blockers get priority reindex + 2-week onboarding extension + 15% credit. Partials get 1-week extension + expedited retry. Offer 1:1 troubleshooting.

Luis (SRE): Quick root cause: transform job dropped nested docs after a recent parser change. Revert applied at 07:25 UTC; backfills started. Current ETA ~3 hours for small queues, up to 6h for larger. Posting progress in channel.

Tara (Product): For renewal-risk accounts offer dedicated success lead and AM escalation. Billing pre-approves credits up to 10% under $5k MRR; AM signoff above. If needed, we can route to a temporary dedicated reindex pool for 48h (ops approval).

Hannah (CS): Draft customer message: "We're sorry — an internal transform issue caused some imports to be incomplete after indexing. Engineering deployed a fix and we're reprocessing affected data. We'll prioritize those most impacted and follow up with an ETA. Your success lead will reach out to coordinate enablement and credits."

Ravi - CS Ops: I'll prepare two templates (blocking + partial) and share for quick signoff. Please confirm credit wording and who to cc for approvals.

Eve (Support): I'll wire a 2-question pulse after the email: 1) Did this block your go-live? 2) Do you want a troubleshooting session? Responses go into the renewal tracker.

Luis (SRE): Progress 07:50 UTC — 30% of queued jobs processed, verification checks passing on processed batches. Will update every 30 minutes. Full postmortem ETA: EOD tomorrow with actions and mitigations.

Hannah (CS): Reminder: cc billing@redwood.com when issuing credits and loop AMs for any at-risk renewals. Once templates are signed, I'll send and schedule enablement slots.

AlertBot: Draft templates uploaded to #cs-review (link) — requesting signoff from @Hannah, @Tara, @Luis.
